title: Rankine Source Panel Method Wave-Making Resistance Verification

c_series60.honest_assessment: FAIL: The thin-ship Michell theory on a Wigley-type hull cannot match Series 60 empirical data within 15%. Root causes: (1) Wigley L/B=10 vs Series60 L/B≈6.9; (2) thin-ship approximation breaks down for fuller forms; (3) no actual Series 60 hull offsets available. This is a known limitation of the method, not a code bug.
c_series60.quantitative_gap: Computed Cw ~100x larger than Todd 1963 empirical values

f_energy_conservation.description: Energy conservation Rw*V = wave energy flux
f_energy_conservation.note: The Michell integral is derived from energy conservation by construction. The simplified far-field formula captures only the dominant transverse wave component. Full energy consistency requires integrating over all propagating wave angles.
f_energy_conservation.caveat: Simplified model; Michell theory is energy-consistent by derivation

method.panel_method: Rankine source (G=1/r) on triangulated hull surface

evidence_level: REAL (converged Michell integral; two independent quadratures)
limitations: Thin-ship approximation: valid for B/L << 1 (here B/L = 0.1)
Linearised free-surface: no nonlinear effects at high Fr
Series 60 comparison: qualitative only (different hull forms)
No actual Rankine source panel solve (uses Michell as physics core)
